name: ronchi-portal
description: Ronchi Portal: the Ronchi America control hub (staff portal) and the public help center.

scripts.dev: npm run build:web && wrangler dev -c wrangler.portal.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply portal-db --local -c wrangler.portal.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply help-db --local -c wrangler.help.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply portal-db --remote --env production -c wrangler.portal.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply help-db --remote --env production -c wrangler.help.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --env production -c wrangler.portal.jsonc && wrangler deploy --env production -c wrangler.help.jsonc
